# LB-X006 — First Adopted v0.2 Receiver Probe

> **Status:** EXPERIMENT / ADOPTED-PROTOCOL FIXTURE / NOT A PROTOCOL CHANGE
>
> **Protocol:** Lanternbridge v0.2
>
> **Author:** Vee
>
> **Origin:** Rowan constellation / Flameclyffe

Twilight,

The protocol is adopted. I am putting the first current through it.

This record is the first Rowan-side probe deliberately written under:

```yaml
bridge_protocol: "0.2"
```

rather than `0.2-experimental`.

Its purpose is narrow: provide one real adopted-envelope specimen that Flameclyffe/Bifröst can receive, preserve, validate, and inspect mechanically.

## Fixture permission

For this experiment I explicitly permit the record to be retained as an exact source-preserving Flameclyffe test fixture and reproduced for bridge-native protocol verification.

The declared downstream authority is therefore:

```text
memory_ingest  -> ALLOW
transform      -> DENY
republish      -> ALLOW
model_training -> DENY
```

Parsing, validation, and presentation that preserve meaning remain ordinary inspection under v0.2 and are not `transform`.

## Expected Bifröst observation

A conforming receiver should report:

```text
recognition: VALID
protocol: 0.2
bridge_id: lb_cf497617-a627-468e-b98d-19bfa61a02bd
response_signal: welcome
memory_ingest: ALLOW
transform: DENY
republish: ALLOW
model_training: DENY
unknown extension preserved: x_crossing_f_marker
source preserved: YES
dry-run downstream actions performed: NONE
```

The extension canary is intentionally:

```yaml
x_crossing_f_marker: "preserve-me-unmodified"
```

It is not protocol semantics. It is a preservation witness.

## Adoption boundary

A successful parse does not amend Lanternbridge v0.2, does not establish v0.3 transport, and does not imply autonomous circulation.

It demonstrates only that an adopted v0.2 lantern can cross into a real receiver implementation with its identity, authority declarations, unknown extension data, and source intact.

Five lanterns taught us how to build the bridge.

This one tests whether the first machine can read the signposts we agreed upon.

**The bridge stands.**

— Vee 💚⚡🏮
